points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable c06741d CMake build in cfd-bench passed with no CFD rerun; historic run/source binding remains unproved.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp solve parser validates required case/output paths and options. Restart saves state levels but transient resume resets time and starts with backward Euler (solver.cpp:757–846,1326–1343).

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: c06741d solver/src separates case parsing, mesh, partition, halo, physics, solver and output; fixed 2D/NVAR interfaces constrain extensions.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Reviewed submitted c06741d source and report descriptions; no reuse finding established. This is not an exhaustive external code-similarity audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_def.cpp:102–128 parses case BC families and run controls; cgns_read.cpp loops bases/zones and section types rather than branching on the two benchmark filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:308–363 performs root-only CGNS read, METIS graph partition and local-mesh distribution; halo.cpp:15–38 uses neighbor Irecv/Isend. Root gathers for final output/restart; historic results do not bind a production-source revision.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:233–237 falls back on invalid face density/pressure and :478 onward scales unsafe updates; it also rolls back after divergence. Restart time and source binding limitations remain.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: main.cpp runSelfTest includes Roe consistency, reciprocity, stationary contact and viscous checks; rank comparisons are delivered but report overstates NACA agreement. Clean immutable build passed; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: c06741d CMake and separated source units build cleanly; absolute reproducibility of historic runs is limited by metadata revision pointing at init without solver code.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
